cause_quote: The new `onChanged: () => context?.broadcast("chat.metadata.changed", {}, { dropIfSlow: true })` callback broadcast every newly settled metadata generation, including rebuilds caused solely by auth usage bookkeeping.
user_saw: Gateway operators saw synchronized bursts of redundant metadata requests from connected Control UI clients after ordinary model calls.
summary: The fix makes metadata revisions and auth snapshot notifications track credential, ownership, and availability changes while ignoring routine usage bookkeeping.
reasoning: I checked that #120926 had already wired metadata generation to the full auth snapshot revision and that bookkeeping-only writes already republished snapshots before #132179. The #132179 diff introduced both the Gateway broadcast on metadata settlement and the Control UI handler that invalidated caches, so the broadcast feature could fan out bookkeeping-driven refetches from its first version.
